description: Starting from the default bottom edge, the dock moves to the top during capture and then returns to the bottom with a horizontal, left-to-right item flow.

assertions.comment: At startup, I see the default bottom panel at y=36 in its 108px-high dock window.
Before I return the dock to the bottom, the top-edge dock window is a 1024x108 horizontal surface.
Before the bottom-edge change, I see the 220px top panel centered at x=402 in the 1024px dock window.
Before the bottom-edge change, I see the floating top panel at y=8.
Before the bottom-edge change, I see a 220px-wide horizontal panel.
Before the bottom-edge change, I see a 64px-high horizontal panel.
Before the bottom-edge change, I see the top dock items flow from left to right.
After I move the dock back to the bottom, its window is again the 1024x108 horizontal surface.
After I move the dock back to the bottom, I see the 220px panel centered at x=402 in the dock window.
After I move the dock back to the bottom, I see the panel at y=36, leaving its 8px floating gap below.
After I move the dock back to the bottom, I see a 220px-wide horizontal panel.
After I move the dock back to the bottom, I see a 64px-high horizontal panel.
After I move the dock back to the bottom, I see the items flow from left to right.
